title: Hindustan 2021: Front End Loader — Operation and Maintenance (NID diploma film)
license: National Institute of Design (item Rights; no reuse statement)
notes: Industrial film for the Hindustan Motors 2021 front end loader, dir. Akhil Succena, NID diploma film 1988, English; the first of five films on Betacam compilation NID-BC0133-BC, running roughly 0:40-20:00 of the tape. Windows: the loader against palms as the Hindustan Motors mark forms, the main title, the GAUGES sequence with its captions and pointing arrows (long), the loader filling a dump truck, the MAINTENANCE caution-and-serial plate, and OIL LEVEL CHECKS over a wheel hub. NOT a film about the year 2021 - 2021 is the machine's model number. Cut from spans fetched over ncaa.gov.in's iOS HLS path (iPhone User-Agent required); the un-fetched spans of the source are black filler, so srcWindows match the original tape.
